projects.name: Hand Gesture Control for Gaming
description: Developed a real-time computer vision system using OpenCV and MediaPipe translating hand gestures into keyboard inputs at 30+ FPS.
Implemented 21- point hand landmark detection with gesture-to-action mapping, achieving 95%+ recognition accuracy across 6 gestures.
Optimized pipeline with multi-threaded video capture and ROI-based detection, reducing latency by 30%(120 ms to 84 ms).
